scope: Saved dev observations and estimates only; report-head shadow replay, not a new closed-loop or PF particle-trajectory evaluation. No test, new render, physics step, model inference, commit, push or PR.

visw.role: fit yaw calibration only; never independent validation
visw.residual_cache: absent in inventory; no inference this round; detector/yaw-scan claims unavailable on this episode

variants.b0u0: Unchanged saved baseline; no runtime or defaults modified when new option absent/OFF.
variants.y1: Own segmentation scan yaw-only discrete MAP refinement about baseline nominal pose, Gaussian penalty using clipped raw yaw sigma. Apply only on measured settled frames, require scan loglik range >=0.25 and interior optimum; no effect on XY, particles, RNG or subsequent prediction. Not an independent measurement or Bayesian covariance update.
variants.s1: Baseline point estimate plus four own load/settle-state yaw variance calibration.
variants.y2: y1 plus same four-state yaw variance calibration, fitted to y1 residuals.
variants.m1: y2 plus persistent own scan residual/ESS alarm; inflate report XY trace to >=0.09 m2 and yaw variance to >=(10 deg)^2. No particle reinitialization in this finite comparison.

yaw_fit.cohorts: s1 uses six teacher dev + VISW, each episode equal total weight; y2 uses six teacher dev only because VISW has no scan cache
yaw_fit.objective: per-state episode-balanced Gaussian yaw NLL on fit only; >=100 samples else pooled grid optimum; tie lower a then lower floor
yaw_fit.stale_rule: when applied scan timestamp unchanged, reported variance >= previous reported variance + q*dt, across state changes; clear only on a new applied scan

mode_fit.input_score: max(clipped normalized edge residual RMS / 3, (1-ess_pre/N)); finite exact edges and censored intervals scored, missing terms excluded and explicitly counted; residual capped at 10 sigma per term
mode_fit.normal: offline fit XY error <=0.10 m AND yaw error <=3 deg
mode_fit.lost: offline fit XY error >0.30 m OR yaw error >10 deg
mode_fit.alarm: 3 consecutive applied scans above threshold; persists across absent/skipped scans; 5 consecutive good applied scans clear
mode_fit.selection: fit episode-balanced lost recall highest among thresholds with normal false-positive fraction <=0.05, tie lower false-positive then higher threshold; if none qualifies disable and mark rejected
mode_fit.validation: lost recall >=0.50 and normal false-positive fraction <=0.05; missing residual/ESS means unavailable, never a normal observation

metrics.loaded_transport: own loaded and skill_phase=nav_preplace; VISW uses own loaded (no matching teacher phase contract)
reported: detector precision, recall, false positives with denominators
metrics.events: maximal contiguous frames where XY error>3sigma OR yaw error>3sigma; gaps in frame index or time>1s split events
metrics.uncertainty_limit: legacy full covariance unavailable: explicitly isotropic XY proxy, never exact NEES
metrics.validation_caveat: These dev episodes were inspected in VIS3/VIS4; no claim of fresh independent generalization.

selection.complete: all nine teacher episodes required; empty door/transport per-episode groups reported, all frames retained
selection.point_guard: validation and all_teacher door_loaded/loaded_transport position p90 <=baseline+0.003m and yaw p90<=baseline+0.3deg; every validation episode all-frame yaw p90<=baseline+0.5deg
selection.y1: validation and all_teacher door_loaded yaw p90 improves >=0.1deg; yaw >3sigma and combined overconfident frame fractions do not increase; all point guards
selection.s1_y2: all point guards; validation yaw NLL improves >=0.05; validation all/door_loaded/loaded_transport yaw 95% coverage in [0.90,0.99] and >3sigma<=0.01; no validation episode NLL worsens >0.10; validation yaw sigma p90<=5deg; combined overconfident frame fraction and event count must not worsen
selection.m1: y2 eligibility plus detector validation rule; validation XY 95% coverage in [0.90,0.99], >3sigma<=0.01, XY NLL improves>=0.05, XY sigma median<=0.10m, combined overconfident frames and events strictly reduced
selection.rank: eligible: validation door position p90 then yaw p90 then combined overconfident frames then yaw NLL then y1,s1,y2,m1 order; none -> b0/u0. Even a shadow winner leaves deployment/defaults OFF.
selection.no_adaptation: No post-result threshold/grid/candidate changes. Implementation fixes recorded; complete rerun on fixed rules if needed.

route_audit.path: consecutive saved estimated loaded_transport poses, joined by linear XY/shortest yaw interpolation; no claim they are a planned or physically swept path
route_audit.continuous_bound: exact center-segment to wall-rectangle Euclidean distance minus circumscribed footprint radius 0.25m; also fixed-yaw swept convex polygon bound, subdividing rotations so each subsegment loses at most 0.25mm rotational error
route_audit.uncertainty: trace-only conservative translation bound 3*std_xy plus yaw displacement 2*0.25*sin(min(pi,3*std_yaw)/2), use max endpoint sigmas; envelope between reports explicitly assumed; subtract tracking0.010+map0.005m
route_audit.contract: geometric clearance >=0.060m, and uncertainty-adjusted continuous lower bound>=0; overlaps and unavailable covariance reported separately; not safety proof

execution.source_freeze: hash all runtime, data and plan before extraction, verify after comparison; git commit forbidden
execution.tensorboard: new native snapshot, read actual data; primary root/display may be blocked by workspace permissions; record scope precisely
